title: Implement site usage, reliability and workflow telemetry

dependency_notes.GQL-01: needed for the token/cost fields and the run identity before MeshGenerate and /api/publish can be instrumented

model_gate: POSITIVE ALLOWLIST: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash only, every role
definition_of_done: One synthetic browser workflow produces correlated UI/API/run events under a single trace_id.
The dashboard shows usage, errors, request latency and completion.
Reconnect/retry does not overcount usage or completion.
Missing instrumentation is visible in the health rollup.
Logging contains no tokens, sensitive strings, raw request variables or free-form user content.
Both the admin site and the product are accounted for in the coverage map.
A measured overhead check accompanies rollout.

steps.do: Copy contract/site-events-v1.schema.json and contract/coverage.json into the product repo at contract/. Do not change a byte; a shape change needs v2.
steps.verify: sha256 of both files matches the inputs above

steps.do: Add telemetry_mount.register(app) to main.py AFTER the OAuth guard is installed. One line.
steps.verify: app startup logs 'SITE TELEMETRY mounted'; SITE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 rolls it back

steps.do: Copy site_events.js to the repo static/js/ and add one <script> tag to base.html.
steps.verify: GET /static/js/site_events.js returns the file; no page content changed

steps.do: Run one headless synthetic browser workflow through the app.
steps.verify: one trace_id spans page.view, ui.action, api.operation and run.transition; JSON captured to evidence/

steps.do: Instrument MeshGenerate and /api/publish once GQL-01's envelope supplies run identity and token/cost fields.
steps.verify: counters() shows both ops; coverage.json flips their instrumented flag to true

steps.do: Instrument the product /graphql endpoint with its own hook on the same contract.
steps.verify: counters(surface='product') returns rows; health() stops reporting the product as missing

steps.do: Set XELOR_TELEMETRY_SALT in the deployed environment.
steps.verify: pseudonym() is stable across a process restart

steps.do: Take the rollout overhead check before and after, same machine, using the perf-tools measuring sticks.
steps.verify: a before/after number pair is written next to this task

hard_constraints: No write outside the declared path set.
No edit to /data/.leviath/config.toml, ceo_bus_metrics.py, or any sweeper script.
No admission file, no outbox write, no bus write.
No new scheduler, queue, service or dashboard.
No credential or permission change. No secret read or write.
No Railway mutation, no restart, no redeploy.
No commit, push, deploy or infra change from this lane.
Never --wait, never --yolo. Never spawn another coordinator.
Do not cite the retired 0104 numeric ceiling.
evidence_required: a written report on disk, with paths and hashes
exact commands, their outputs and exit codes
the source/base commit and the resulting diff
actual provider spend, with blocked/passed/verified states distinguished
open_items_kept_honestly: No Bead: bd is not installed on this box ('bd: command not found'). This is a real task file, not an invented bead id.
No live browser workflow was run during backlog prep.
No dashboard was rendered during backlog prep.
